content: .{@-मुखम्@} (or आस्यम्) that part of an act, wherein the subject of all the acts is intimated, is called अङ्कमुख, which suggests the {%germ%} as well as the {%end%}; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} in <ls>Māl. 1</ls> कामन्दकी and अवलोकिता hint the parts to be played by भूरिवसु and others and give the arrangement of the plot in brief (यत्र स्यादङ्क एकस्मिन्नङ्कानां सूचनाखिला . तदङ्कमुखमित्याहुर्बीजार्थख्यापकं च तत् .. <ls>S. D. 322.</ls>) The Daśarūpa defines it thus: अङ्कान्तपौत्ररङ्कास्यं छिन्नाङ्कस्यार्थसूचनात् . {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} where a character at the end of an act cuts short the story and introduces the beginning of another act; as in the second of <ls>Mv.</ls>
